notes: 5000 painted rounded rectangles. Canvas focused before measurement; all 119 recorded samples were visible and focused.
Frame intervals measure browser scheduling; canvasCpuMs measures CPU preparation, not GPU completion. No sustained 60 FPS claim.

An earlier run without continuous focus validation recorded a 1116 ms interval. A no-edit requestAnimationFrame control also reached 1018 ms while unfocused, and CPU profiling found 980 ms idle spans. Those unfocused frame measurements are not a valid comparison of editor throughput.
readyMs is a warm recovery load with cached WASM, not cold startup.

storage.scope: Retained JS file byte arrays in an isolated synthetic IndexedDB database, not total browser/WASM/GPU RAM. Migration is a one-time cost.
